fact: President Boko's State-of-the-Nation Address, reported 2025-11-11 as delivered the previous Monday, said Parliament also passed the Access to Information Act; the report does not say it was promulgated or in force.

The document is the text of the Access to Information Act, Act 16 of 2024, which creates a general right of access to information held by public authorities; it states commencement is on notice, and the document is dated 2024-07-26.
